verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents creating an avatar 'from a single photo', which turns a still image of a person into a moving presenter. That is a narrow, avatar-only form of image animation rather than general image-to-video. Nothing shows that arbitrary stills are animated or that composition and background are preserved. Missing for 10: general image-to-video for non-avatar subjects, evidence of subject and composition fidelity, motion or prompt controls for animating stills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
